fusions.name: Snatched Morsel
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage, heals you for 30% of it and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dine and Dash
fusions.desc: A burst around you that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. You move 25% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Worked-Up Appetite
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you. Its healing rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Fuel for the Road
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, you restore 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
